name: HYDRA-UMC-PHYSICS-REPLICA
notes: Established v0: real forward kinematics and joint-limit validation (`fk`/`validate-limits` subcommands) over a real, documented-partial URDF subset (single serial chain, revolute/continuous/prismatic/fixed joints). Plus a real joint-limits corpus (src/corpus.rs) and a fail-safe `fk-checked` subcommand: forward_kinematics_checked() refuses to compute a world-frame pose for a joint position outside its declared URDF limit, closing the gap where plain fk would silently compute a physically-unreachable pose. 33 tests. Real MuJoCo/PhysX rigid-body and contact simulation stays future work - genuinely blocked on integrating an actual physics-engine dependency, not just unwritten code.
